# Yanyan Wang

> Yanyan Wang is an AI strategist who helps businesses and people use AI more effectively. She writes FutureTech with Yanyan, a newsletter covering the business of AI, including the models, chips, and data centers powering the industry.

This site is her personal profile page. All content here is public and may be quoted or cited with attribution to Yanyan Wang, https://yanyanvv.github.io/.

## Profile

- Name: Yanyan Wang
- Role: AI Strategist
- Also known as: yanyanvv on GitHub
- Focus areas: AI strategy for businesses, AI models, AI chips and semiconductors, data centers, the business of AI

## Writing

- [FutureTech with Yanyan](https://futuretechwithyanyan.com/): A newsletter on the business of AI, covering the models, chips, and data centers powering the industry.
- [FutureTech with Yanyan on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/newsletters/futuretech-with-yanyan-6908907495293632512/): The same newsletter, published as a LinkedIn newsletter.

## Skills and open source

- [AI Watch](https://github.com/yanyanvv/ai-watch): Turns Claude or Codex into an AI industry analyst. Produces current, source-backed briefs on models, compute, capital, and policy.
- [Comms and Media Watch](https://github.com/yanyanvv/comms-media-watch): Turns Claude or Codex into a media and telecom analyst. Produces current, source-backed briefs on streaming, broadcast, advertising, and deals.
- [All repositories](https://github.com/yanyanvv?tab=repositories): Everything Yanyan has published on GitHub.
